notes: Recorded 395 master's rows and 346 doctoral rows from six universities that published a readable list: master's {'Peking University': 207, 'Beijing Foreign Studies University': 56, 'Shanghai University of Finance and Economics': 16, 'Northwestern Polytechnical University': 16, 'Shanghai International Studies University': 58, 'Donghua University': 42}; doctoral {'Peking University': 256, 'Beijing Foreign Studies University': 21, 'Shanghai University of Finance and Economics': 3, 'Northwestern Polytechnical University': 16, 'Shanghai International Studies University': 23, 'Donghua University': 27}. Each row is one major at one university, and a major taught in both languages at one school appears once per language.
This is not the whole Type B list: Type B is run by many Chinese universities and no single official list of them or of their majors could be read. Only these six universities' lists were readable.

Peking University: the 2026 catalogue (Chinese-taught and English-taught, master's and doctoral) was read from the per-school PDFs. 15 majors offered only part-time were left out because the notice covers full-time programmes. The 2026 English-taught catalogue links for the School of Foreign Languages (master's and doctoral) and the School of Advanced Agricultural Sciences (doctoral) lead to missing files, so those English-taught lists are absent. A 2027 catalogue is also published; the 2026 one matches the notice read.
Peking University's health science centre (medicine) is not in these catalogues, so no medical majors are recorded.

Beijing Foreign Studies University: the Type B notice points to an admitting-majors page that returns 'not found', so the rows come from the university's 2026 international-student master's and doctoral programme pages, which the notice also points applicants to for each major's requirements. The match between those lists and the Type B majors is not confirmed by the notice.

Northwestern Polytechnical University: its 2027-intake lists name 43 master's and 33 doctoral majors; only the starred ones (16 master's, 16 doctoral), which the page says are supported by the Chinese University Program (Type B), are recorded.

Donghua University: the master's list is the 2027 one and the doctoral list is the 2026 one (the 2027 doctoral list was not yet published); both lists are images that were read by eye, and the Type B page names the master's and doctoral lists as the eligible programmes. Rows are one per programme, with the teaching languages given together.
Shanghai University of Finance and Economics: the master's list is headed 2026 entry; the doctoral page names three programmes. The notice says all graduate programmes are eligible.

Shanghai International Studies University: only rows marked with the Chinese Government Scholarship in its 2026 table are recorded; the Chinese-taught majors have only Chinese names in the table, so those names are given in Chinese. English names are given where the table's English-taught sheet shows them.

Names: where the source gives an English name beside the Chinese one it is used; Peking University's English names are its own. Peking University school names are in Chinese except for the schools named in English on its English-taught index page.
